integrated_verification.outcome: All executable local gates passed: validate 559/559 with 92.91%/85.26%/95.31% coverage, build, E2E 51/51, accessibility 6/6, security, audit, performance 7/7, recovery 5/5, docs, OpenAPI, traceability, migrations and PostgreSQL 22/22. limitations: The JSONB snapshot remains runtime authority; the relational seam is not cut over.
No populated backfill, dual-read, authority rollback or approved representative relational workload exists.
The real PostgreSQL proof covers two pools and a wake-up only, not two complete HTTP instances with SSE fan-out, revocation, reconnect or soak.
Production storage, scanner, keys, TLS, ingress, alerting, restore and RPO/RTO are not authorized or proven.
Remote CI/provenance, signed clinical policies, manual acceptance, training, pilot and hospital release authority are absent.
Two fresh independent critic attempts timed out; no independent approval is inferred.
